caption: The drawing shows a dress with matching pantaloons, both rendered in shades of red with vertical gold stripes and accents. The dress has short, puffed sleeves with ruffled edges at the shoulders and cuffs, a high waistline, and a full skirt with a ruffled hem. The pantaloons are also trimmed with ruffles at the bottom ends. Beside the main colored drawing, there is a small, uncolored outline sketch of the same outfit in the top right corner of the image. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Child's Dress
